name: Party Laser
author: Vaster Than Life

augments.name: Disco Ball
augments.desc: Purely for vibes. Requires mod scripts to sparkle.

events.text: A drifting space rave is pumping out bass so hard your hull rattles.

success.text: Best night of the war. Someone leaves you a gift.

fail.text: Somebody spilled a drink in the reactor.

choices.text: Keep the volume down and move on.

script: VTL.on('arrive', function(){ if(VTL.G && VTL.G.ship.augments.indexOf('discoball')>=0) VTL.toast('The disco ball sparkles. The crew feels great.'); });
